name: Lazer UI
description: A smooth, music-reactive menu overhaul inspired by osu!lazer.

enabled.name: Enable Lazer menu
enabled.description: Replace the main menu with the Lazer-style menu. Takes effect next time the menu loads.

check-updates.name: Check for updates
check-updates.description: Lazer UI isn't on the Geode index, so it checks GitHub for new versions when the game starts and offers to install them.

restyle-popups.name: Restyle popups
restyle-popups.description: Give GD's popups (rewards, confirmations, info boxes...) the dark osu!-style look. Other mods' popups are left alone.

restyle-gameplay.name: Lazer pause and results
restyle-gameplay.description: Show the pause menu and the level complete screen the osu! way. GD's options and other mods' pause buttons stay reachable from them. Off by default: GD's own screens stay.

restyle-profiles.name: Lazer profiles
restyle-profiles.description: Show player profiles (yours and everyone else's) as a full osu!-style page instead of GD's popup.

intro.name: Intro and outro
intro.description: Play an animated intro when the game starts, and a "see you next time" outro when you quit.

music-player.name: Menu music player
music-player.description: Instead of the menu theme, play the songs of your downloaded levels one after another, and show the playing level's thumbnail (from the Level Thumbnails community) as the menu background. The toolbar's music button opens the player.

ventilla-radio.name: Ventilla radio
ventilla-radio.description: With JoseII's Ventilla installed, its live radio plays in the menus instead of your levels' songs. Off: your songs play and the radio keeps quiet. The music player has the same switch (the radio button).

ui-sound-volume.name: UI sound volume
ui-sound-volume.description: Volume of the menu's sounds (hover, click, intro). Separate from GD's SFX volume, so the menus can have sound with game SFX off. 0 turns them off.

ui-scale.name: UI scale
ui-scale.description: Size of the menus, in percent. Phones default to a bigger UI since their screens are small. Takes effect next time the menu loads.

player-icon-colors.name: Use player cube colors
player-icon-colors.description: Use your saved primary and secondary colors for the large menu cube. Turn off for the original contrast colors. Applies next time the menu loads.

background-dim.name: Background dim
background-dim.description: How much to darken the menu background, in percent.

background-blur.name: Blur background
background-blur.description: Blur the menu background, like osu!.

background-triangles.name: Background triangles
background-triangles.description: Show slowly drifting triangles over the background.

parallax-background.name: Background parallax
parallax-background.description: How far the menu background follows the mouse (on phones, the tilt), in percent of the screen.

parallax-menu.name: Menu parallax
parallax-menu.description: How far the main menu's buttons follow the mouse (on phones, the tilt), in percent of the screen.

tilt-parallax.name: Tilt parallax
tilt-parallax.description: Move the menu with the phone's tilt (gyroscope and accelerometer).

scroll-volume.name: Scroll to change volume
scroll-volume.description: Like osu!: the mouse wheel turns the music up and down wherever nothing else scrolls in Lazer's screens, and anywhere in the menus with Alt held. Meters for the music, effects and interface sounds pop in at the left while you do; scroll over one to change that one.

custom-cursor.name: osu! cursor
custom-cursor.description: Replace the mouse pointer with osu!'s menu cursor, which squashes, glows and taps when you click.

cursor-rotation.name: Cursor rotation
cursor-rotation.description: The osu! cursor tilts as it moves and turns to follow the mouse while you drag.
